description: Patch releases are deliberately not automerged here, unlike in most other roles in this fleet.

n8n applies its own TypeORM migrations from the application process at startup, forward-only, before it serves anything: a fresh 2.36.0 instance applies 208 of them on first boot. Patch releases do ship migrations - 2.35.1 -> 2.35.2 added AddReasonToWorkflowPublicationOutbox - so an automerged patch would rewrite the schema of the database holding the users' workflows and the third-party credentials those workflows authenticate with, unattended and with no way back short of restoring a backup.

The release cadence makes that worse rather than better: 2.36.0 through 2.36.6 were all published within four days. Automerging patch releases would mean an unattended, schema-touching upgrade of a running automation engine on most days of the week. That cadence is also why the regex manager below is held to opening branches on Mondays.
Both failure modes are caught by the Molecule run on the pull request, which is exactly the checkpoint that automerging would remove.

The versioning=semver annotation in defaults/main.yml is what keeps this repository off n8n's flavour-suffixed tags. n8n publishes 2.36.6-amd64, 2.36.6-arm64 and 2.36.6-<commit> alongside the plain 2.36.6, and semver reads each suffix as a prerelease identifier, so Renovate skips them and follows the clean tags only.
